newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Sept housing starts rise 2.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Sept housing starts rise 2.2 pct.

text.p: Canadian housing starts rose by 2.2 percent in September to a seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) of 131,600 units from a revised 128,800 units in August, the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corp (CMHC) said on Tuesday.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast housing starts of 133,000 units.
Actual housing starts rose to 12,326 in September from a revised 12,064 the month before. The SAAR is a monthly figure adjusted to remove normal seasonal variation and multiplied by 12.
